SOURCE EXCERPT:
Course syllabi are filed with the registrar by the end of the first week of classes and are published in the course catalogue system, where they remain available to students for the duration of the term. Syllabi for courses taught under a non-disclosure agreement with an industry partner are filed with the registrar but not published, and the department records the agreement's reference number in the file. Examination schedules are published in the same system at the start of the term and may not be changed after the eighth week except by the dean's approval on the written request of the instructor. Grade distributions by course are published at the end of each term without instructor names. A course with fewer than five enrolled students is omitted from the distribution report.
